message.content:
**Image 1 (Mobile Hero – Light)**
PASS  
The deep rust-terracotta primary button is highly readable against the oat background and feels professional.

**Image 2 (Mobile Hero – Dark)**
PASS  
The terracotta button with dark ink text provides excellent contrast and legibility on the dark theme.

**Image 3 (Demo Video – Light)**
PASS  
Typography is clear, the play button matches the brand palette, and the layout is well-spaced with no clipping.

**Image 4 (Demo Video – Dark)**
PASS  
All text remains legible, the video thumbnail integrates smoothly, and the warm accent colors pop correctly.

**Image 5 (Cookie Banner – Light)**
PASS  
Both “Accept” (terracotta) and “Reject” buttons are clearly readable with sufficient contrast.

**Image 6 (Pricing – Dark Desktop)**
CONCERN  
The cookie consent banner overlaps and obscures the bottom of the pricing cards (“No lock-in…” line is partially hidden).

---

### Summary of Checks
*   **(a) Buttons/Links:** Yes. The deeper rust in light mode and terracotta-with-dark-ink in dark mode look premium and are very readable.
*   **(b) Clipping/Overlapping:** Yes. Image 6 shows the cookie banner overlapping critical pricing content at the bottom of the viewport.
*   **(c) Cohesive Palette:** Yes. The oat + terracotta palette feels cohesive, warm, and premium across all screens.
*   **(d) Cookie Banner Readability:** Yes. Buttons are distinct and readable in both modes.

### Overall Score: **8 / 10**
The visual design and color execution are excellent (would be a 9 or 10), but the **z-index/overlap issue on the pricing page (Image 6)** is a functional UX bug that needs fixing before launch.
